## Goal

Deploy the SSSSY (Soil Science Society of Syria) website to free hosting — backend on Railway, frontend on Vercel, database on Neon.tech (PostgreSQL).

## Instructions

- Use fully free stack: Railway (backend) + Vercel (frontend) + Neon.tech (PostgreSQL)
- GitHub repo: `https://github.com/nmed1234/ssssy-websit.git`
- Neon DB connection string: `postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_CSEwZ1Ag9Gyh@ep-jolly-tooth-asms1hcn.c-4.eu-central-1.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require`
- Railway public URL: `https://ssssy-websit-production.up.railway.app`

## Discoveries

- Project is Next.js 14 frontend + Spring Boot 3.2 backend + PostgreSQL
- Railway env vars ARE correctly set and working — DB connects to Neon successfully (`HikariPool-1 - Start completed`)
- **Root crash cause**: Multiple Flyway migration SQL files reference `updated_at = NOW()` in `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET` clauses on the `menus` table — but the `menus` table has NO `updated_at` column. This keeps killing startup.
- `grep` found **5 migration files** with this pattern across **15 occurrences** total:
  - `V26__seed_global_site_settings_and_footer.sql` — lines 23, 36, 45
  - `V29__seed_page_sections_for_public_pages.sql` — line 24
  - `V41__rebrand_ssss_and_add_logo_setting.sql` — lines 10, 16, 23, 43, 61, 78, 91
  - `V44__add_site_name_bilingual.sql` — lines 21, 39
  - `V45__add_footer_copyright_bilingual.sql` — lines 22, 40
- V21 was already fixed (removed `updated_at = NOW()`)
- Redis autoconfiguration was disabled in `application.yml` to prevent Redis startup crash
- `logging.file.path` was removed from `application.yml` to prevent write errors in container
- The migrations run in order; currently stuck at V26 (V21–V25 completed successfully)

  ## ✅ Fix Applied — V26 Migration

  **Root cause confirmed:** The `menus` table only has `created_at` — no `updated_at` column. V26 line 45 was trying to `SET updated_at = NOW()` in an `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` on `menus`, which crashed the migration engine.

  **Fix:** Removed that single line. All other `updated_at` references across V29, V41, V44, V45 are on `content_strings` and `system_config` — both have the column, so those are fine.

  ------

  ### Step-by-step Vercel deployment:

  **1. Go to [vercel.com/new](https://vercel.com/new)**

  **2. Configure the project:**

  | Setting              | Value                                  |
  | :------------------- | :------------------------------------- |
  | **Framework Preset** | Next.js (auto-detected)                |

  | **Build Command**    | `npm run build` (default, leave as-is) |
  | **Output Directory** | `.next` (default, leave as-is)         |

  **3. Add Environment Variables** (click "Environment Variables" section):

  | Name                   | Value                                                        |

  **4. Click Deploy** → wait ~2 minutes
